# EmDash SEO Suite — Complete Technical Specification

## Overview
The EmDash SEO Suite (`@emdash/plugin-seo`) provides WordPress SEO plugin feature parity (Rank Math Pro, Yoast SEO Premium, All in One SEO) for Astro and EmDash CMS.

Designed as an in-process native plugin with zero external runtime dependencies, it executes with sub-millisecond overhead to guarantee complete compatibility with Cloudflare Workers Free Tier (< 10 ms CPU constraints) and standard Node.js runtimes.

## Key Subsystems
1. **Schema Graph Generator:** Emits unified schema.org JSON-LD graphs linking WebSite, Organization, LocalBusiness, WebPage, Service, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, and ItemList.
2. **Content Analyzer:** Evaluates focus keyword presence across title, URL slug, meta description, first 100 words, and subheadings, verifying keyword density (0.8% - 2.5%), heading hierarchy, and image alt text.
3. **Automated Breadcrumbs:** Dynamically constructs hierarchical breadcrumb trails from URL pathnames with schema.org microdata and accessible ARIA attributes.
4. **Automated Table of Contents:** Scans content for H2 and H3 elements, generates slugified anchor IDs, injects jump links into HTML, and outputs Google ItemList schema.
5. **Edge Protocols:** Edge-rendered XML sitemaps (with auto-sharding and image tags), virtual robots.txt, and AI crawler llms.txt.
6. **Edge Redirections:** In-memory matcher for exact, prefix, and regex 301/302/410 redirects.
7. **WordPress Importer:** Direct REST API ingestion tool extracting posts, pages, custom taxonomies, Kadence FAQ blocks, and Rank Math/Yoast metadata into EmDash seed format.
